mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization via TECO; no Hague Apostille applies for Taiwan; do not combine with any apostille step.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All shareholders, directors, ultimate beneficial owners, and operational managers are screened against the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, PRC Ministry of Commerce embargo and anti-sanctions lists, and Taiwan Financial Supervisory Commission AML alerts at formation and on an ongoing basis. Enhanced due diligence applies to politically exposed persons (PEPs) using risk-based methodology; each PEP's source of wealth and source of funds is verified with banking documentary evidence. All screening records are retained for not less than five years, and any hit requires immediate suspension and escalating to the local FIU.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System (NECIPS) and SAMR Online Name Pre-registration portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: A Chinese enterprise name must follow four tiers: (1) administrative division; (2) trade name; (3) industry or business characteristics; and (4) legal form suffix, e.g., 'Limited' or 'Co., Ltd.'. For foreign-invested entities, the Chinese name must be in simplified Chinese characters, and the English name, if used, is a transliteration that cannot be used for official filings unless registered as the legal foreign name. Phonetic transliteration of the foreign investor's brand must avoid homophones or characters carrying negative connotations.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a name rejection, the applicant may (i) apply for administrative reconsideration with the same SAMR within 60 days of receipt; or (ii) directly file an administrative lawsuit with the people's court having jurisdiction within six months. A written appeal, with the original rejection notice, must include the specifically claimed re-drafted name. The SAMR has 10 business days to respond. For extension, the original reservation holder may submit a renewal request five business days before expiry, demonstrating ongoing regulatory approval or financing condition; one 30-day extension is permissible.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or commercial mailbox cannot satisfy the physical presence requirement for an ISIC 6311 foreign-invested company in mainland China when the company uses Apple IAP and Paymentwall rails. Tax authorities require a fixed address for issuing VAT invoices and for unannounced audit access; banks require an in-person compliance meeting and proof of lease for account opening. The use of any virtual office triggers refusal of a bank account and a material risk of license revocation by SAMR.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk of unannounced physical inspection by tax and SAMR authorities within the first 12 months is 70-85% for Medium-Risk_Enhanced digital business startups. Checklist: (1) correctly branded corporate nameplate matching the registry; (2) valid commercial lease exceeding one year; (3) actual employees on payroll with social insurance records; (4) books and records covering the first three months of operation; and (5) a physically present China-based responsible person.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Taiwan has no separate Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture Act; the applicable vehicle is a Company Limited by Shares under the Companies Act of Taiwan, Articles 1, 128-156 (incorporation, capital and shares), 172-193 (directors and meetings), and 387 (registration); foreign investment is separately approved under the Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals, Article 8.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan, acting through the Taiwan One-Stop Company Registration Portal
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Company Registration with the Articles of Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital applies under Taiwan's Companies Act; the paid-in capital stated in the Articles of Incorporation must be fully subscribed and, for a foreign-invested JV, the non-resident investor's capital must be remitted into a Taiwan escrow account and verified by a CPA before the MOEA registration is granted.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: The shareholders' subscriptions to the initial paid-in capital are accepted; the registered office is approved at the address in the Articles of Incorporation; the board is authorized to open the corporate bank and foreign-investment escrow accounts; [Name] and [Name] are appointed directors, with [Name] as Chairperson and [Name] as General Manager; the Chairperson is authorized to execute the registration application and the General Manager is delegated to obtain corporate seals, complete the MOEA filing, submit the foreign-investment application, and take all other lawful actions needed to commence the Company's business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment Approval and Beneficial Ownership Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the foreign-investment application online before any Taiwan incorporation filing. Include the JV shareholders' agreement, beneficial ownership declarations, source-of-funds statement, and a draft capital schedule. The approval letter is the precondition for inward remittance and issuance of capital.
required_dossiers: Board or shareholder resolution of each investing entity
Passport or certificate of incumbency and beneficial owner declaration
JV agreement and draft Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If queried, submit supplementary declarations within 14 days; if rejected, file an administrative appeal to the Executive Yuan or resubmit after curing the stated defect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name and Business Scope Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company Name and Business Scope Pre-inspection System, MOEA
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for a name pre-reservation and business scope codes under Taiwan's standard industry classification, using the code set corresponding to online video chat and data processing. The reservation is valid for six months and must precede the incorporation filing.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name fails for duplication, choose a materially different Chinese and English name; if the scope is rejected, narrow the scope in the pre-inspection system before resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Escrow, Capital Remittance and CPA Capital Verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Designated foreign exchange bank and certified public accountant
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary escrow account in the proposed corporate name, receive the inward remittance from the foreign investor, keep the funds in New Taiwan Dollars, and obtain a CPA capital verification report reflecting the fully subscribed capital. The report must be dated within 15 days before the incorporation filing.
required_dossiers: Bank escrow or capital remittance receipts
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If remittance is misclassified, instruct the bank to apply to the Central Bank for foreign exchange reclassification; if the CPA queries capital provenance, supplement bank statements and source-of-funds documentation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Registration and Incorporation Certificate Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the incorporation application via Taiwan's One-Stop Company Registration Portal together with the approved articles, capital verification report, director consents, and registered office address evidence. After MOEA examination, the Company receives the Certificate of Incorporation and a Uniform Business Number.
required_dossiers: Registered office use consent and lease
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MOEA issues a correction letter, make corrections online within 15 days; if registration is rejected, resubmit after remedying the stated defect or appeal to the Minister of Economic Affairs.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance; Labor Insurance Administration; National Health Insurance Administration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 15 days after incorporation, complete business tax registration for uniform invoices, employer withholding registration, labor and national health insurance enrollment, and occupational accident insurance coverage for all staff.
required_dossiers: Uniform Invoice and Tax Registration Application
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax registration is queried due to address or scope, amend the registration online with corrected supporting documents; labor insurance errors are cured through retroactive enrollment with payroll evidence.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Governance Implementation and Digital Service Compliance Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors; Ministry of Digital Affairs, Taiwan
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting to adopt officer mandates, bank signatory and corporate seal custody rules, and internal AML controls. Because the video-matching service is not a physical factory, confirm that no industrial factory operating permit is required; if the service will interconnect with public telecommunication routing, file a Class-B telecommunications registration notice with MODA.
required_dossiers: AML internal policy for Medium-Risk digital payment rails
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MODA queries the service classification, supplement network architecture details and resubmit under the correct interconnection category.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Digital Affairs, Taiwan; no physical factory inspectorate jurisdiction is triggered
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable to the software-application business; optional registration as a Class-B telecommunications enterprise if real-time voice/video traffic is interconnected with public networks

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Administration, Executive Yuan, Taiwan
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from the Environmental Impact Assessment Act because the activity is a pure cloud-based video matching service with no stationary industrial installation and no Category I-III development threshold is crossed
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No point-source industrial discharge is generated by the core data-processing activity; if office sanitary wastewater exceeds the regulatory threshold under the Water Pollution Control Act, a discharge permit is required; any emergency backup generator and HVAC refrigerants must comply with Taiwan's air pollution and refrigerant management standards.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate and annual fire safety equipment inspection for office premises under the Fire Services Act; workplace risk assessment and occupational accident insurance compliance under the Occupational Safety and Health Act; no structural load inspection clearance is required because no heavy machinery or high-density industrial storage is installed.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance, Taxation Agency (Taiwan); E-Tax Portal: https://www.etax.nat.gov.tw
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity deriving business income in Taiwan, or having a fixed place of business, must apply for a Tax Identification Number (TIN) with the local National Taxation Bureau within 15 days of business commencement. The procedure: (1) execute a written application on the standard form, (2) submit certificate of incorporation from the home jurisdiction, (3) provide proof of appointment of a statutory tax representative resident in Taiwan if no local branch manager exists, (4) submit a power of attorney where applicable, and (5) obtain the TIN certificate upon verification. Electronically, the E-Tax Portal supports pre-registration and document uploads.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Taiwan does not offer check-the-box elections; corporate income tax applies at the entity level. A qualifying group of affiliated enterprises (direct/indirect cross-holding of at least 20%) may elect consolidated return filing, and certain business transactions allow an advance pricing agreement election. No hybrid mismatch elections exist under domestic law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: TWD 200,000 average monthly revenue (for mandatory registration as a VAT taxpayer)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory issuance of government-standardized Uniform Invoices (電子發票) for most business-to-consumer sales, with real-time data transmission to the Ministry of Finance E-Invoice Platform through standardized APIs; cloud-based invoice clearance is required for registered operators. Digital stamping and digital signature validation are embedded in the e-invoice QR code.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to exports of goods that are physically shipped out of Taiwan under customs procedures; services provided to foreign enterprises and overseas individuals, or services partially rendered abroad; and international transport of goods or passengers. The taxpayer must possess customs export declarations and sale contracts demonstrating the foreign consumption nature to claim the zero-rate.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Airway Bill
Inward Remittance Certificate or Foreign Exchange Settlement Record
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Taiwan National Taxation Bureau scrutinizes zero-rating refund claims through sample audits and document verification. Fraudulent or unsubstantiated claims result in repayment of the refunded tax plus a fine of up to five times the underpaid tax under Article 51 of the Value-Added and Non-Value-Added Business Tax Act, and where intentional evasion is proven, criminal liability under the Tax Evasion Act may attach, including imprisonment and additional fines.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: For a PRC-incorporated Sino-foreign equity joint venture: the People's Bank of China (PBOC) is the central bank; the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) administers foreign-exchange controls, generally through designated banks. For Taiwan-side accounts or counterparties, the Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan) and Taiwan's Ministry of Economic Affairs are separate authorities. Taiwan is not a PRC banking or foreign-exchange jurisdiction. Confirm the entity's place of incorporation and the meaning of jurisdiction code TW before account opening or remittance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The renminbi is not fully convertible on the capital account. Current-account transactions, including bona fide trade and eligible service payments, are generally convertible through an authorized bank after review of the underlying transaction and supporting documents. Capital-account transactions, including registered foreign-invested enterprise capital contributions, equity transfers, shareholder loans, and certain cross-border financing, are subject to registration, permitted-use, macro-prudential, or other regulatory requirements. A PRC foreign-invested enterprise may generally remit after-tax profits abroad through an authorized bank, subject to tax compliance, audited financial statements, statutory-reserve requirements, board or shareholder resolutions, and verification of distributable profits. Banks may request tax-payment or tax-filing evidence and proof of the recipient's entitlement. Taiwan-related investment and remittances may require separate cross-strait investment approvals, reporting, or restrictions; do not assume that ordinary foreign-investment procedures alone are sufficient.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no general mandatory foreign-exchange surrender ratio requiring an ordinary PRC enterprise to convert all export proceeds into renminbi. Foreign-currency retention and settlement are generally permitted through compliant accounts, subject to bank review, transaction authenticity, applicable SAFE rules, and relevant account-use restrictions. Export receipts must be supported by genuine trade documentation and correctly reported or reconciled under applicable customs, tax, and foreign-exchange procedures. No single universal statutory repatriation deadline or conversion ratio applies to every export receipt; applicable timing depends on the transaction, account arrangement, and current rules. The app's digital services, subscriptions, advertising, or platform receipts should not be characterized as goods-export proceeds without confirming the actual contractual and payment flows.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: RMB basic deposit account and, subject to eligibility and bank approval, foreign-currency capital account and foreign-currency settlement account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low as a substitute for a PRC domestic corporate bank account. An offshore electronic-money institution account does not replace required PRC account opening, SAFE-related processing, or domestic settlement arrangements. Use only a properly licensed provider for permitted payment flows, complete PRC and destination-country KYC, and verify that the proposed service can lawfully serve the PRC entity and the relevant Taiwan-connected transactions. Paymentwall or another payment intermediary requires separate review of licensing, merchant-of-record allocation, settlement currency, chargebacks, data flows, and PRC cross-border payment documentation. Apple in-app purchases are platform settlements, not a general-purpose corporate banking rail.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No universal rule requires every director to attend in person, but onboarding is bank- and branch-specific. The legal representative, account signatories, beneficial owners, and authorized agents may be required to attend identity verification or interviews. Some banks support remote verification for eligible applicants; a PRC-incorporated entity should plan for an in-person branch visit and should not rely on remote opening until the selected bank confirms acceptance. Taiwan-based identity documents, corporate records, and powers of attorney may require notarization, authentication or other bank-accepted formalities and certified Chinese translations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear entity jurisdiction, inconsistent description of a PRC joint venture and Taiwan jurisdiction, or unresolved Taiwan investor status.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Business licence, articles of association, joint-venture contract, shareholder register, ultimate-beneficial-owner chart, investor identity and incorporation documents, PRC foreign-investment filing or information-reporting evidence as applicable, and written clarification of the relevant PRC and Taiwan entities and transaction roles.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital contribution or shareholder funding lacks an approved, registered, or otherwise bank-verifiable capital-account basis.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Capital verification or contribution records where applicable, corporate resolutions, subscription and joint-venture documents, investor remitter details, bank-accepted foreign-investment registration or information-reporting evidence, remittance instructions stating the correct purpose, and supporting SAFE or bank processing records.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Video-chat or social-app activity, user-generated content, cross-border calls, or payment flows raise sanctions, fraud, consumer-protection, cybersecurity, or licensing concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed business and revenue-flow memorandum, platform and payment-provider contracts, user terms and privacy notices, content moderation and age-control policies, sanctions-screening procedures, fraud and chargeback controls, data-flow and cybersecurity assessments, and a PRC regulatory analysis confirming required permits or explaining why the specific activities do not require them. Reassess licensing independently; the payload's 'requires_statutory_license: false' is not a legal determination.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Third-party collections, payment aggregators, opaque beneficial ownership, unusually high-risk jurisdictions, or settlement amounts inconsistent with the stated app business.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete funds-flow diagram, contracts and invoices, merchant and platform statements, settlement reconciliations, customer and counterparty profiles, beneficial-ownership evidence, sanctions and adverse-media screening, refund and chargeback records, and an explanation of any third-party payer or payee.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Outbound profit remittance, service-fee payment, or related-party payment without evidence of distributable earnings, tax compliance, or genuine underlying services.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited financial statements, tax filings and payment evidence, board or shareholder resolutions, distributable-profit calculation and reserve evidence, intercompany agreement, invoices and service-delivery evidence where relevant, transfer-pricing support, recipient ownership details, and bank-required remittance and tax documentation.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route investor capital from the investor's own verified account to the JV's bank-designated capital-account channel, using the exact legal entity name and bank-provided remittance instructions. Complete applicable PRC foreign-investment information reporting or registration and bank/SAFE processing before remittance; identify the payment accurately as registered capital or another permitted funding instrument, not as trade proceeds or an undocumented shareholder loan. Provide the joint-venture and subscription documents, investor and beneficial-owner evidence, corporate approvals, source-of-funds records, and any Taiwan-side approvals or filings. The receiving bank must confirm the permissible account, currency, conversion, and use of funds before execution. Retain SWIFT messages, bank receipts, registration records, and accounting entries. Do not route through an employee, unrelated affiliate, personal account, or payment intermediary to bypass controls.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For bona fide cross-border vendor or service payments, use an authorized PRC bank and the appropriate current-account or other permitted payment process. Provide contracts, invoices, evidence of delivery or service, tax and withholding documentation where applicable, counterparty and beneficial-owner information, and accurate payment-purpose descriptions or codes required by the bank. SWIFT MT103 is a payment message, not an authorization or proof of regulatory compliance. Commercial letters of credit may be used for eligible documented trade under the issuing bank's rules and applicable trade-finance requirements; they are generally not a substitute for evidence supporting digital-service, platform, or related-party payments. Reconcile platform settlements, refunds, fees, and foreign-exchange conversions to contracts and accounting records. Taiwan-connected payments require separate review of PRC cross-strait rules and Taiwan-side requirements.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable foreign-exchange forwards with an authorized bank, subject to eligibility, genuine exposure documentation, and applicable bank and SAFE requirements
Non-deliverable forwards where offered by an authorized counterparty and permitted for the entity, subject to applicable regulatory and documentation requirements
Foreign-exchange swaps with an authorized bank, subject to permitted purpose, counterparty documentation, and applicable regulatory requirements

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual General Meeting and Approval of Financial Statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Company internal record; minutes retained in registered office; audited statements submitted to tax authority and Investment Commission where applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after fiscal year-end (by June 30 for a December 31 year-end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Directors may be fined NT$10,000–NT$50,000 per violation under Company Act Articles 170 and 228; MOEACA may order convening; persistent failure may lead to administrative dissolution

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Declaration of Directors, Supervisors, Managers and Major Shareholders (UBO Declaration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Commerce and Business Administration (MOEACA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Initial fine NT$50,000 (approx. USD 1,700); repeated non-compliance fines up to NT$500,000 (approx. USD 17,000); administrative strike-off if company remains non-compliant after statutory notices

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after fiscal year-end (by June 30 for a December 31 year-end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file may trigger warning, suspension of repatriation of capital or profits, and cancellation of foreign investment approval

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Administration, Ministry of Finance

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Compulsory audit applies if paid-in capital exceeds NT$30 million (approx. USD 1 million) or if the company is an approved foreign-invested enterprise; the competent authority may also require audited financial statements for companies with significant debt or financial distress
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Non-public companies must follow the Business Entity Accounting Standards (Taiwan GAAP) or FSC-endorsed IFRS; publicly traded companies must apply IFRS as adopted by the Financial Supervisory Commission

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Each year, before March 31, the JV must submit an online annual confirmation to MOEACA listing all shareholders holding 10% or more, directors, supervisors, managers and the ultimate beneficial owner. Any share transfer or ownership change during the year must be reported within 15 days; failure to update is a separate violation and may incur fines.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: The headline 20% profit-seeking enterprise income tax (PSEIT) is partially mitigated by: (1) an R&D investment tax credit of 15% of qualifying R&D expenditures under Article 10 of the Statute for Industrial Innovation (subject to a statutory sunset and annual caps); (2) a 5% surtax on undistributed earnings at the close of the year under Article 66-9 of the Income Tax Act, which incentivizes current-year dividend distribution; (3) an imputation tax credit regime historically available to resident shareholders (now replaced by a partially integrated imputation system); (4) a foreign tax credit on excess foreign income taxes carried forward five years; and (5) eligibility for government-subsidized investment allowances for digital service exports. The minimum effective tax burden for a profitable JV normally ranges between 20% and 25% once the retained-earnings surtax is applied.
